- Updated all Via* addons

- Fixed ESC action to actually open the parent screen
- Made the GUI pretty
- Added ViaLegacy/ViaAprilFools

- Added BetaCraft MpPass for classic servers
- Added per-server-version system
- Added F3 debug hud
